summary: hitachivantara.vspone_block 13.7.0 renamed parameters across modules such as hv_gad, hv_hg, hv_hur, hv_iscsi_target, hv_ldev and hv_resource_group (for example nick_name to nickname, ports to port_ids, mirror_unit_id to mirror_unit_number).
questions: What is the new name for nick_name in hv_hg?
Why does hv_resource_group no longer accept start_ldev?

answer_card.title: vspone_block parameter renames (part 1)
answer_card.answer_md:
Renamed input/output parameters in hitachivantara.vspone_block:

- `hv_gad`: `mu_number` → `mirror_unit_number`
- `hv_hg`, `hv_iscsi_target`: `nick_name` → `nickname`, `ports` → `port_ids`, `port` → `port_id`, `should_delete_all_ldevs` → `should_delete_all_volumes` (facts modules: first three)
- `hv_hur`: `mirror_unit_id` → `mirror_unit_number`, `primary_journal_pool` → `primary_journal_id`, `secondary_journal_pool` → `secondary_journal_id`
- `hv_ldev`: `parity_group` → `parity_group_id`
- `hv_resource_group`: `start_ldev` → `begin_ldev_id`, `end_ldev` → `end_ldev_id`, `parity_groups` → `parity_group_ids`, `ports`/`port` → `port_ids`/`port_id`
- `hv_sds_block_compute_port`: `nick_name` → `nickname`
- `hv_sds_block_journal`: `mirror_unit` → `mirror_unit_number`
